A modern farm tractor seen from the rear quarter to show its connection points. The large rear tyre has deep V-shaped treads. At the back, clearly label the upper central link and the two lower lift arms forming a triangle (Three-point linkage). Below them, a flat metal bar with a hole (Drawbar). Above the drawbar, a splined rotating stump (Power Take-Off shaft). Clean flat textbook illustration, white background.

Side-by-side comparison of a disc plough and a mouldboard plough. Left: A disc plough showing three heavy saucer-shaped steel discs mounted on a heavy tubular frame, with a heavy rear furrow wheel. Right: A mouldboard plough showing a sharp horizontal share at the bottom, curving up into a twisted steel mouldboard plate, and a straight metal landside piece sliding behind it. Clean flat textbook illustration, white background.
